Lily wanted to build a tower, but he needed to make a tall tower. He saw a big stack of sand and wanted to build a tower. He thought it would be fun and exciting.
But then, a little bird came and said, "I need help. I can make tall towers!" The bird was angry and said, "No, that is not our tower! I am strong and fun!"
Lily was sad. She didn't know what to do. She thought the tallest would be fun. But she did not know what it was.
But then, something unexpected happened. A big wind came and tried to build the tower all by itself. The tower had a crack on top of the tower. The tallest tower was now tall and hard. Lily was scared and started to cry.
